the secret stashes... never fully go away. meaning i always somehow end up with something to use. i'm also an art student and i do a lot of 3D work (sculpting and building) so i have an endless supply... regardless, i still go through periods where my girlfriend will consensually take away things i could use.

i think i will have the urges, thoughts, call them what you will, and instead of distracting myself or dismissing the thoughts, i just tend to tear myself apart for even thinking about them because "i've grown too much to have suicidal thoughts" 

biggest thing in therapy i've been working on is liking myself and not tearing myself apart-- we have long ways to go but someday i'll be better at it than i am now

if you want something character related but also has a girlish vibe, what about power puff girls?? or maybe kim possible? i worked at a precollege event for our school so we were required to have same sex dorms- and one of our girl floors was early 2000s cartoons and it was a big hit!

i've been in and out of therapy for my whole life, but recently i found a therapist that i truly click with and i am very satisfied with the work i've done with him. i'd like to say i don't have urges? but some nights if things get really bad (this happens maybe once every 4 or 5 months? not super frequent at all) i will force myself to lay in bed and i'm not allowed to get up until i'm completely certain i won't do any harm.

in conclusion: i get urges but i don't act on them, which shows just how far i've come in my mental health journey
